description: Data provenance and lineage tracking for CUI is not implemented. This signal indicates that the origin and handling history of sensitive data cannot be verified.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring data integrity verification. Includes data lineage tracking, origin verification, and data handling audit trails.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through data provenance capability review, lineage tracking verification, and data handling audit assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
